settings.heading: Four things that make one softgel enough
settings.footnote: *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

settings.title: Real Ceylon, never Cassia
settings.text: Only true Ceylon bark from Sri Lanka goes in. It's the cinnamon that's naturally very low in coumarin, which matters when you take it every day.

settings.title: A real amount in one softgel
settings.text: A sprinkle of kitchen cinnamon is a tiny dose. Each softgel holds 600mg of 12:1 extract, made from about 7,200mg of bark. One a day, no handfuls of capsules.

settings.title: Carried in MCT oil
settings.text: Cinnamon's key compounds are oil-loving, so we suspend the extract in MCT oil from coconut. Smooth to swallow, no cinnamon taste.*

settings.title: Nothing hidden on the label
settings.text: Non-GMO, gluten-free, 30 softgels per pouch. The real milligrams are printed on the front, and the 90-day guarantee covers you if it's not for you.
